other_conditions: Societies must be at least three years old with a positive net worth balance for the last three years and relevant experience in the proposed project area.
The three‑year age and net‑worth requirement may be relaxed for government‑sponsored projects at the discretion of the Managing Director, NCDC.
Societies must be registered under the Cooperative Societies Act of the respective state.
Societies must undertake activities related to agriculture and allied sectors such as marketing, storage, processing, and input supply.
Societies must be financially viable with a good track record.
Societies must be eligible for financial assistance from NCDC.

Eligible sectors include agricultural marketing, processing, storage, computerization, weaker‑section programmes, input supply, plantation/horticultural crops, SC & ST cooperatives, tribal cooperatives, hill area cooperatives, dairy, poultry, livestock, fisheries, handloom, coir, jute, cash crops, sericulture, DCCB, State Cooperative Banks, spinning mills, and related modernization or rehabilitation projects.
benefits_summary: Provides grant‑in‑aid subsidies ranging from 15% to 25% for cooperative projects, with higher subsidy rates for less‑developed states.
